limited:
recursive fn make(n:i64)->u16[..4]{if n==0{return[];}if n==1{return[7];}return[7,8];}
fn main(){assert(make(0)==make(0));assert(make(1)!=make(2));assert(make(2)==make(2));print("limited");}
refs:
recursive fn make(p:i64&)->i64&[2]{return[p,p];}
fn main(){var a:i64[]=[7];var b:i64[]=[7];assert(make(a[0])==make(a[0]));assert(make(a[0])!=make(b[0]));print("refs");}
loop_exit:
recursive fn make()->i64[2]{return[7,8];}
fn main(){var visits:i64=0;var hits:i64=0;for i in 4{visits++;if make()=={if i==0{continue;}if i==3{break;}[7,8]}{hits++;}}assert(visits==4);assert(hits==2);print("loop_exit");}
